_about: The standard drive cycles bundled with LightSim (backend/app/cycles.py).
Each id has a <id>.csv trace (t_s, speed_kmh). 'register' is its row in
docs/data-register.csv; 'phases' are [name, start s, end s]; 'published'
is the regulation's [duration s, distance km], which test_cycles.py holds
the trace to. Never change a shipped trace in place: a changed cycle gets a
new id, so a run stored with the old one can still be reproduced.
